cohort: A 34-year-old hemodialysis patient who experienced a late second-trimester miscarriage.
finding: A 34-year-old hemodialysis patient developed peripartum cardiomyopathy with features of left ventricular noncompaction after a late second-trimester miscarriage, which showed complete regression upon stringent dry weight control and pharmacological heart failure therapy.
gest_age: late second trimester (at time of miscarriage)
